newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish official says unemployment fell in May.
newsitem.headline: Spanish official says unemployment fell in May.

text.p: Spanish employment secretary Manuel Pimentel said on Monday the total number of unemployed fell in May, local press agencies reported.

Pimentel did not refer to any speficic data, but said that May "was a good month," for employment. He added he was confident that a positive economic trend would limit inflation rate with a lowering effect on interest rates.
According to the National Statistic Institute (INE) joblessness fell in April by 45,799 units to a unemployment rate of 13.61 percent versus 13.89 percent in March.
